tracesTo: SOW: Tech Stack - Next.js API routes

stories.title: Implement Next.js API Route Architecture with Middleware
stories.goal: establish a standardized API route structure with authentication and error handling middleware
stories.benefit: consistent API behavior, reusable middleware patterns, and simplified route implementation
acceptanceCriteria: API routes follow RESTful conventions with proper HTTP method routing (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)
Authentication middleware validates Supabase session tokens and populates request context with user data
Error handling middleware catches exceptions and returns standardized error responses with appropriate status codes
Request validation middleware enforces schema validation using Zod or similar library
Rate limiting middleware prevents API abuse with configurable limits per endpoint

stories.title: Implement Server Actions for Data Mutations
stories.goal: use Next.js Server Actions for form submissions and data mutations with automatic revalidation
stories.benefit: type-safe mutations, automatic loading states, progressive enhancement, and optimized client-server communication
acceptanceCriteria: Server Actions implement all create, update, and delete operations for core entities (users, leagues, teams, picks)
Actions validate input data using schema validation before database operations
Successful mutations automatically revalidate affected routes using revalidatePath() or revalidateTag()
Actions return typed success/error responses compatible with useFormState hook
Transaction rollback occurs on validation or database errors with descriptive error messages

stories.title: Implement Core Entity CRUD Operations
stories.goal: create complete CRUD API routes for users, leagues, teams, and memberships with proper authorization
stories.benefit: complete data access layer for core platform entities with enforced business rules and security
acceptanceCriteria: User CRUD operations enforce RLS policies and allow profile updates, avatar uploads, and preference management
League CRUD operations validate commissioner permissions, enforce unique slugs, and handle league settings updates
Team CRUD operations validate uniqueness constraints, handle logo uploads, and maintain league associations
Membership operations enforce role-based access (commissioner, member, viewer) and handle invite workflows
All operations log audit trails for administrative actions and enforce soft deletes where appropriate

stories.title: Implement Social Feed Query System
stories.goal: build efficient queries for newsfeed, comments, reactions, and user engagement data
stories.benefit: performant social features with proper pagination, filtering, and real-time updates
acceptanceCriteria: Newsfeed queries fetch posts with pagination (cursor-based), filtering by league/user, and include author/reaction counts
Comment queries support threaded replies with depth limits, sorting options, and reaction aggregations
Reaction queries aggregate counts by type (like, celebrate, insightful) with user participation tracking
Engagement queries track user activity metrics (posts, comments, reactions) with time-based aggregations
All social queries implement proper indexes and use query optimization techniques to maintain <200ms response times

stories.title: Implement Commissioner Content Management Queries
stories.goal: create queries for power rankings, predictions, and commissioner content with autosave functionality
stories.benefit: reliable content management system with draft support and version history
acceptanceCriteria: Power rankings queries fetch/update weekly rankings with drag-drop ordering, team associations, and commentary
Prediction queries manage commissioner predictions with status tracking (pending, correct, incorrect) and scoring
Autosave queries implement upsert operations with timestamp tracking and conflict resolution
Draft management distinguishes between published and draft content with proper visibility controls
Version history queries track content changes with rollback capability and author attribution

stories.title: Implement Matchup and Pick'em Data Queries
stories.goal: build queries for bracket matchups, pick submissions, grading, and leaderboard calculations
stories.benefit: accurate pick'em system with real-time standings and automated grading
acceptanceCriteria: Bracket queries fetch matchup trees with team details, game times, and current pick distributions
Pick submission queries validate game locks, enforce deadlines, and support confidence point allocation
Grading queries automatically score picks based on game results with configurable point systems
Leaderboard queries aggregate user scores by week/season with tie-breaking logic and ranking calculations
Historical queries provide season-long statistics including accuracy percentages, streak tracking, and head-to-head records

stories.title: Implement Transaction History and Filtering Queries
stories.goal: create queries for transaction logs with advanced filtering, sorting, and aggregation capabilities
stories.benefit: comprehensive audit trail and analytics for all platform activities
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction queries fetch all entity changes (creates, updates, deletes) with user attribution and timestamps
Filtering supports multiple criteria (entity type, user, date range, action type) with efficient query composition
Aggregation queries provide summary statistics (activity by user, changes per day, popular actions)
Promotional history tracking logs league promotions to home feed with engagement metrics
Export functionality generates CSV/JSON reports of filtered transaction data for administrative review

stories.title: Implement Data Validation and Business Rules Layer
stories.goal: enforce schema validation and business rules at the query layer before database operations
stories.benefit: data integrity, consistent validation, and early error detection with helpful error messages
acceptanceCriteria: Schema validation uses Zod schemas matching database column types with custom error messages
Business rule validation enforces constraints (unique league slugs, valid date ranges, game lock times)
Authorization checks verify user permissions before executing queries (commissioner-only actions, league membership)
Relational integrity validation ensures referenced entities exist (teams in leagues, users in memberships)
Validation errors return structured responses with field-level error details for client-side form handling

stories.title: Implement Standardized Error Handling and Transaction Management
stories.goal: create consistent error handling patterns with proper transaction rollback and error reporting
stories.benefit: reliable data operations, easy debugging, and consistent error responses across all API endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Database transactions wrap multi-step operations with automatic rollback on any failure
Error responses follow standardized format including error code, message, field errors, and request ID
Database errors map to appropriate HTTP status codes (400 for validation, 404 for not found, 500 for server errors)
Error logging captures full context (user, endpoint, parameters, stack trace) for debugging
Retry logic handles transient failures (connection timeouts, deadlocks) with exponential backoff

stories.title: Implement Query Performance Optimization Layer
stories.goal: optimize database queries with caching, pagination, and query planning for sub-200ms response times
stories.benefit: fast page loads, reduced database load, and scalable data access patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Query optimization uses database indexes, proper JOIN strategies, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE for performance tuning
Caching layer implements Redis/in-memory cache for frequently accessed data (league details, user profiles)
Pagination implements cursor-based pagination for large datasets with configurable page sizes
Query batching combines multiple related queries using DataLoader pattern to prevent N+1 queries
Performance monitoring tracks slow queries (>200ms) with automatic alerts and query plan logging

stories.title: Implement Supabase Integration Layer
stories.goal: integrate Supabase Auth, RLS policies, and real-time subscriptions with API routes
stories.benefit: secure data access, real-time updates, and simplified authentication flow
acceptanceCriteria: Auth integration validates Supabase JWT tokens and creates authenticated Supabase clients for queries
RLS policy enforcement ensures all queries respect row-level security rules defined in database
Real-time subscriptions enable live updates for social feed, leaderboards, and live game tracking
Service role queries bypass RLS for administrative operations with proper authorization checks
Edge function compatibility ensures queries work in both Node.js and Edge runtime environments

stories.title: Implement External API Integration Queries
stories.goal: create query layer for fetching and caching external sports data (ESPN, odds providers)
stories.benefit: reliable external data integration with fallback handling and cache optimization
acceptanceCriteria: Sports data queries fetch game schedules, scores, and odds from external APIs with error handling
Caching strategy stores external API responses with TTL based on data freshness requirements (live vs historical)
Fallback logic handles API failures by serving cached data or degraded functionality
Rate limiting respects external API quotas with queuing and throttling mechanisms
Data transformation layer normalizes external API responses to match internal database schema
